## Summary
Reviewed head d82e7c3634fd. The lone mobile ToolBubble and the ToolDetailModal now show the amber terminated state when a tool's terminated reason is set, using a new shared module (`chat/ToolTermination.tsx`) that ActivityGroup also uses. I ran the new tests and the existing ActivityGroup, ToolBubble, ChatView and MessageBubble-adjacent suites in a copy of the worktree: all pass. I checked parity against the dashboard ToolBubble and the app's ActivityGroup, and walked every `onOpenDetail` caller.

## Strengths
- ActivityGroup behaviour is unchanged: the replaced inline icon had identical props (`stop`, size 12, `accentOrange`, same testID, same stopped / turn terminated label rule). Its existing terminated tests still pass.
- The `onOpenDetail` signature gains one trailing optional parameter. The only callers are ToolBubble (passes `message.toolResultTerminatedReason` last, in the right slot), MessageBubble (passes the prop straight through) and ChatView's `handleOpenDetail` (eighth positional, stored in `toolDetail`, forwarded to the modal). No positional mix-up.
- The modal replacing the synthesized result with the cautious sentence matches ActivityGroup (summary replaces result text) and the dashboard (synthesized text withheld, note shown). The note is always visible in the lone bubble, as on the dashboard.
- One predicate (`getToolTermination`) now backs three surfaces, so they cannot drift. No new tap targets; the existing 44pt close button and bubble hit area are untouched.
- Mutation results (run on a copy, not the PR worktree): predicate returning null, label forced to terminated, header icon removed, note removed, reason dropped from the `onOpenDetail` call, and modal rendering the raw result all turn the new tests red. Controls cover normal, failed, pending and reason-without-result.

## Critical
None.

## Suggestions
1. FOLD (cheap): the ChatView seam is unguarded. Dropping `toolResultTerminatedReason` from `handleOpenDetail`'s `setToolDetail` call, or removing the `toolResultTerminatedReason={toolDetail?.toolResultTerminatedReason}` prop on `<ToolDetailModal>`, leaves all 25 relevant tests green, yet it silently disables the modal fix in the real app (the eighth positional argument is the exact slip this signature change invites). One ChatView-level test (render with a terminated tool message, open the detail via the bubble, assert the modal shows `tool-detail-terminated`) would close it.
2. DEFER/FOLD: the commit message carries no `Trial-Closes:` line (only the PR body does). If the squash commit is built from the commit rather than the PR body, add it.
3. In the modal terminated row the 12px icon is top-aligned against an 18px line-height note, so it sits slightly high. Cosmetic; `alignItems: 'center'` or a 3px top margin would line it up.

## Nitpicks
- Comment in `ToolBubble.terminated.test.tsx` says the bubble would render "red-failed" without the change; the lone ToolBubble has no red-failed styling, so it would just render plain.
- In the modal, `termination ? null : parseWebToolResult(...)` is redundant, since the terminated branch is checked before `webParsed` is used (removing it changes no behaviour). Harmless.
- The modal's icon label ("stopped" / "turn terminated") duplicates the adjacent note text for screen readers; fine, but the icon could be hidden from accessibility there.

## Verdict
Approve.

| step | verdict | head |
|---|---|---|
| connect app to isolated daemon (manual connect), session screen | PASS | 3683da7 |
| model picker → Haiku 5.5, tiny prompt, reply | PASS | 3683da7 |
| changed feature — ActivityGroup terminated row (stop while the Bash permission is pending): amber stop icon + "Stopped before this tool ran…" with the full reason in the accessibility label | PASS | 3683da7 |
| second session, switch back keeps transcript (1-turn transcript; also run at the base commit for comparison — identical) | PASS | 3683da7 |
| switch back after a 2-turn transcript with a mid-run stop | blank viewport once at this head; base comparison inconclusive. Not attributable to this diff (ChatView/MessageBubble changes only thread one optional field to the detail modal; the same row rendered before the switch). Recorded as a follow-up | 3683da7 |
| lone ToolBubble / ToolDetailModal | N/A — not reachable from live data at this head (every tool_use is grouped by buildChatViewMessages); covered by unit tests | 3683da7 |

Observed, pre-existing, recorded as follow-ups: a mid-run stopped tool shows a red error row with the raw "The user doesn't want to proceed…" text rather than the amber terminated state; the terminated reason is truncated to one line visually; "thinking" dots persist on a stopped session.
